concurrent.note: In one process the VLM's token read holds the Python GIL (the HailoRT 5.x binding does not release it), so the same-process figure is what the TraceBrief server would see; the second-process figure isolates device contention.

second_process.reason: DeviceError: The UGen300 is already open in another process: HailoRT returned HAILO_LIBUSB_FAILURE (98). On a Windows host over USB only one process can open the device (HailoRT 5.3.2 on Windows: LIBUSB_ERROR_ACCESS), and TraceBrief runs both models in one process. Stop the other process (another TraceBrief server or scan, scripts/hailo/bench_ugen300.py, hailortcli) and try again; if none is running, reconnect the UGen300.
second_process.note: Expected on a Windows host with the UGen300 on USB (HailoRT 5.3.2): only one process can open the device, so the second process's VDevice fails with HAILO_LIBUSB_FAILURE (LIBUSB_ERROR_ACCESS) and device contention between processes cannot be measured there. It may work on a Linux host or over M.2; not tried.
